name: Möllfluss Camping
beschreibung: Möllfluss Camping is located in the valley floor of the Mölltal, not far from the center of Heiligenblut. The campsite is situated directly on the Möllfluss, adjacent to the federal road that leads to the Großglockner. The pitches are basic, some with electricity and water hookups. Guests can reach the cable car and the village center on foot. Access to the Großglockner Hochalpenstraße is in the immediate vicinity.
